reviews.t: The good stuff

claims.text: Reviewers frequently report that the castor oil is genuinely pure and thick, unlike diluted products.
Many customers say it made their eyelashes and eyebrows thicker or helped hairline growth.
Several reviewers report using it on or around their eyes, including for lubrication, puffiness, dark circles, and vision.
Some customers take it orally and report digestive benefits or cleansing effects.
A few reviewers mention packaging or dispensing issues, such as a missing dropper or wishing for a pump dispenser.

qa.q: Will this make my eyelashes and eyebrows grow thicker?
qa.answer: Yes, multiple reviewers report thicker eyelashes and eyebrows after using it [2][3][4][6]. One reviewer notes thickening but not much added length after about a month [4], while others report both length and thickness [3][6].

claims.text: It made eyebrows and eyelashes thicker within 15 days.
Reviewer noticed added length and thickening to brows and lashes in a short time.
Reviewer reports lashes are thicker though not much longer after about a month.
After about 3 months of nightly use, reviewer saw thick and long lashes and brows.

qa.q: Is it safe to use around my eyes?
qa.answer: Reviews describe using it in and around the eyes, including one drop in each eye nightly [1][4] and applying it on the eyes at bedtime [3], with one reviewer calling it a safe remedy for use under their son's eyes [2]. However, these are individual experiences and the reviews do not provide a general safety assessment for eye use.

claims.text: One reviewer put one drop in each eye every night at bedtime.
Another reviewer put a drop of castor oil in each eye nightly.
One reviewer applied it on their eyes at bedtime.
One reviewer described it as a safe remedy used under their son's eyes.

qa.q: Does it have a strong smell?
qa.answer: Reviews indicate it does not have a strong or unpleasant smell: one notes it doesn't have the old-time smell [3], and another says it smells better than other castor oils [5].

claims.text: It doesn't have the old-time smell like back in the day.
It smells better than other castor oils.

qa.q: Is it really 100% pure and organic?
qa.answer: Reviews describe it as genuine 100% castor oil and organic [1][2], with one noting it is hexane free [5]. However, no review provides certification or lab verification of purity, so the claim rests on customer perception.

claims.text: One reviewer calls it the only genuine, 100% castor oil they have found, noting its thickness and dark bottle [1].
Another reviewer states it is organic and very pure [2].
A reviewer notes it is hexane free [5].

qa.q: How long until I see results?
qa.answer: Reviews report varying timelines: eyelash and eyebrow thickening within 15 days [1] or about one week [2][6], hairline fill-in within a couple of days [5], and hair thickening after a few weeks [3].

Big difference in eyelashes after about one week.
Longer lashes and eyebrows in one week.
Hairline began filling in within a couple of days.
